name: showtime
description: Movie & event ticket booking platform built as microservices — seat locking, saga-based payments, idempotent APIs, event-driven notifications.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,catalog,booking,payment,notify,web -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,gray,white "npm:dev -w services/gateway" "npm:dev -w services/auth" "npm:dev -w services/catalog" "npm:dev -w services/booking" "npm:dev -w services/payment" "npm:dev -w services/notification" "npm:dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,catalog,booking,payment,notify -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,gray "npm:dev -w services/gateway" "npm:dev -w services/auth" "npm:dev -w services/catalog" "npm:dev -w services/booking" "npm:dev -w services/payment" "npm:dev -w services/notification"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis mongo mailpit
